semantics.goal: Carry the rigidly attached L-shaped object around the declared upper or lateral route, clear the obstacle with the whole object, and settle at the requested pose.
excludes: regrasping or changing the rigid tool-object attachment
counting a tool-center-point path that leaves the carried object in collision
treating delay, payload, or servo variation as a separate subtask

evidence: carried-object pose relative to the declared route corridor

success: the whole carried object clears the obstacle
terminal object error is within 5 mm and 3 degrees
terminal pose is held continuously for 0.3 seconds before the 10 second deadline
anti_bypass: evaluate carried-object geoms instead of tcp crossing
require the declared route event before terminal acceptance

requirements: both declared routes complete from disjoint initial states
whole-object collision and terminal pose are independently replayed
source actor and configuration digests are frozen
no failed source episode is replaced
source_qualification.evidence_resolution: every control tick plus terminal physics state

historical_evidence_policy: Existing obstacle-transfer results remain immutable evidence under their original protocol; this semantic contract does not relabel or overwrite them.
